snippet.title: ACE Strategy - Gamescom 2024 Official PV｜The Mecha TCG
snippet.description:
ACE Strategy, The Mech TCG, is coming to Gamescom this August!  Come try out our two amazing ACE Mechs, “Orion” and “Battle Core”and fight the boss ”Crux“ to stop the universe from vanishing!  

Visit us in Hall 10.2 | Stand F042g, Koelnmesse in Cologne during August 21-25！ 
Please add us to your Steam wishlist!  Follow us on X and join our Discord channel !!
